diagnosis.body: Counter increment follows await launch and safe-disposition validation, before qualifier; it counts safely completed workers, not all engine invocation attempts.
diagnosis.adapter: Existing exec-start is before byteInput and member-call evaluation, so it alone does not prove actual invocation. This particular rejected invocation is proved by its captured Bash.exec/execInScope stack.

proposedChanges: New schema/recipe identity; never add fields to frozen original own-data schema in place. Keep legacyCompletedCounts separately labeled.

Resolve/authenticate operation, input, callable method and receiver once before call-attempt; failures in argument/method preparation are not product invocation. Preserve exact method receiver and getters-once behavior.

Emit bounded operation/call-ID-correlated attempt record immediately before invoking the selected function. Attempt means reaching the dispatch boundary; an abrupt exit between event and call cannot establish callee entry.

Record fulfilled immediately after awaited resolution, before output conversion/snapshot/qualification; record rejected on synchronous throw or promise rejection, preserving explicit reason presence including undefined/null/false/0/empty string. Do not use truthiness or serialization/coercion to choose primary.
Emit setup and semantic records separately. Empty setup uses existing zero-dispatch/namespace-preservation/barrier assertions; C11 remains disallowed in semantic mode.

Supervisor derives counts from retained ordered records before rejecting worker disposition; incomplete/lost/outcome-missing records produce unresolved/unknown and unsafe stop, not inferred success or zero.

Keep physical worker spawn/exit/close/reap, call settlement, resource/capture errors and semantic qualifier orthogonal. A fulfilled status7 can match an expected outcome; fulfilled never implies semantic pass.

Count every observed rejection even if worker later exits nonzero. Caught offline violation still fails admission/safety even if an outer call fulfilled. Preserve primary plus cleanup errors independently.

finiteOwnDataRecord.reason: null except rejected: exact bounded own-data discriminant with explicit presence; no arbitrary object getters/toString, no raw secrets
finiteOwnDataRecord.census: exact IDs from frozen99operations; comparator one semantic call, target one empty setup then one semantic call; no repeated ordinal; fulfilled/rejected requires prior attempt and no prior settlement

counts.invariant: attempted = fulfilled + rejected + unresolved for complete observed attempt stream; missing capture separately unknown, not fabricated0

budget.qualification: These are proposed finite per-event ceilings, not guaranteed fit. Charge existing262144record/FD3,32MiBdocument and248+8MiB evidence partitions; exhaustion remains unsafe. No new retry/case/budget.

unknownPolicy: An attempted event records dispatch attempt, not guaranteed callee entry. Missing durable outcome remains unresolved even if outcome existed transiently; missing/truncated attempt transport is unknown. Never reconstruct from process exit or success-only final counts.
